personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, premium event experience blending elegant typography with sophisticated glass surfaces, anchored in navy and champagne gold.

spacing.rule: Use generous vertical editorial spacing to let typography breathe. Inputs and buttons should feel substantial but not cramped. Ensure safe areas are strictly adhered to.

do's: Use frosted glass overlays on hero cards with imagery underneath.
Use a glass sticky container for primary CTA over scrolling form content.
Use glass for the QR pass header / overlays.
Pair blur with translucent tinted base (≥70% surface opacity) to ensure readability.
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields.
Do not use glass on plain white backgrounds with no underlying image or texture.
Avoid stacking more than two glass surfaces simultaneously.

screens.name: Public Event Landing
screens.purpose: A cinematic entry point to attract and convert student registrations.

states.loading: Spinner overlaid on the background image
states.error: Failed to load event details. Retry.

screens.layout: Full-bleed 'hero_wedding' image under a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse/Navy). The title 'OLAM 3.0' in Playfair Display ≥3xl at the bottom-left of the view. A sticky 'Register Now' Champagne Gold (brandPrimary) CTA anchored securely above the home indicator in a glass container. Staff login accessible via a subtle transparent button at the top right.

screens.name: Student Registration Form
screens.purpose: Collect attendee details smoothly with clear validation and actionable flow.

states.error: Error submitting registration. Please check inputs.

screens.layout: Ivory (surface) background. Playfair Display large title at the top. Single-column form layout. Inputs have 'border' and 'surfaceTertiary' backgrounds. Group related inputs into full-screen modal overlays to keep context intact. Provide immediate validation. A sticky 'Submit' CTA anchored at the bottom inside a KeyboardAvoidingView wrapped in a glass container.

screens.name: Digital QR Pass Ticket
screens.purpose: A secure, hierarchical ticket meant for high-efficiency scanning and aesthetic delight.

states.empty: No approved pass found. 'Registration Pending Approval'.

screens.layout: Navy (surfaceInverse) background or card wrapped over 'abstract_gold_bg'. High contrast hierarchy: event timing/details above the QR code, attendee name/ID immediately below it. The QR code must be centrally aligned with a pure white background for scan hardware efficiency. Subtle geometric shapes or faint overlays for premium feel.

screens.name: QR Scanner (Camera)
screens.layout: Camera viewfinder takes up the entire screen. A dynamic glass bottom-sheet slides up immediately on scan. It flashes background/border colors based on result: Success Green (#10B981) for allowed, Amber Warning (#F59E0B) for already checked in/duplicate, Red Error (#EF4444) for invalid/unapproved.

screens.name: Admin/Coordinator Dashboard
screens.purpose: Manage registrations, view stats, and access reports in a modern card-grid view.

states.empty: No registrations yet. 'Share the event link!'.

screens.layout: Ivory background with 'surfaceSecondary' (Pure White) cards. Use a multi-column grid (wrap, space-between) for stat cards (e.g., Total Regs, Checked-in). Cards feature subtle shadow_tier 1. A clean data table / list layout underneath for registration management with 'Approve/Reject' buttons in a swipeable row.

hero_wedding.alt: Stacked champagne coupes with gold rims at a formal event

abstract_gold_bg.alt: white textile with subtle abstract gold accents

instructions_to_main_agent: Design Identity: Strictly adhere to the Editorial + Luxe hybrid. Use Navy (#0B192C) as the inverse/brand base, Champagne Gold (#D4AF37) for CTAs, and Ivory (#FDFBF7) for the primary surface. Note: Navy is an explicitly allowed exception per the user's brief.
Typography: Use Playfair Display exclusively for headings/titles to enforce the 'Grand Wedding' aesthetic, and Inter for all body, labels, and UI text.
Web Search Learnings: Registration forms should bundle related inputs or use full-screen modals to avoid overwhelming users. Ensure real-time immediate feedback chips/toasts for form submissions.

Web Search Learnings (QR Pass): Keep the QR code large, central, and on a solid white square to ensure hardware scan efficiency. Critical journey details sit above the QR code, supplementary details (Name, ID) sit below.
Navigation & Layout: Always pin primary CTAs (like 'Register' or 'Submit') to the bottom of the screen inside a glass-container if scrolling over content. Keep safe area clearances.
Scanner Colors: Ensure scan results utilize the provided status tokens (#10B981, #F59E0B, #EF4444, #3B82F6).
No Emojis: Strictly ban emojis across the entire UI.
